title: Tim Cook, Sir Jony Ive KBE, and Laurene Powell Jobs | Full Interview | Code 2022
summary: Kara Swisher interviews Apple CEO Tim Cook, designer Jony Ive and Laurene Powell Jobs at the 2022 Code Conference. They discuss Apple's history, design, privacy and advertising, and the company's future leadership.
